title: DATABASE SYSTEM IMPLEMENTATION
description: CSEE W3827 is recommended. The principles and practice of building large-scale database management systems. Storage methods and indexing, query processing and optimization, materialized views, transaction processing and recovery, object-relational databases, parallel and distributed databases, performance considerations. Programming projects are required
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: ( COMS W4111 ) and COMS W4111 ; fluency in Java or C++.
